text: {"lessons":["My account fell for several months, then recovered without further trades; I should not assume a short-term decline will continue or that I can reliably time a rebound.","I bought more shares during the downturn, but prices still moved both ways afterward; I should make purchases according to a planned allocation and keep enough cash for future needs.","A recent recovery has not fully erased the earlier losses, so I should judge progress over the long term and keep my investing risk aligned with my apartment goal and ability to tolerate losses."]}
